title: Answer Context Source Filter QA
principle: Receipt highlights should carry source-level metadata when it is safe and available, while keeping raw chat and knowledge content out of public/frontend receipts.
public_repo_rule: Source filters store only IDs, counts, source labels, model labels and target panel names. They store no prompt text, response text, memory text, knowledge snippets or provider secrets.

scenarios.expected: Latest memory-use review IDs are copied into the receipt and panel filter metadata.
Panel highlight shows the number and source labels of memory matches without showing memory text.
Model drill-down carries the selected receipt model into panel dataset metadata.
Filter and highlight metadata explicitly exclude raw prompts, raw responses, memory text, knowledge snippets and provider secrets.
